🔄 I'd swap pushdowns for Low-to-High Cable Fly. It keeps your chest working with very little elbow bending under load. Dips and overhead extensions are in the library, but they stress the elbow more, so skip them today. Tap the card to swap.

⚠️ Keep the weight light and stop if the elbow hurts. If the pain is sharp or doesn't go away, have a professional look at it. Your bench and overhead press are still on the plan today. How does the elbow feel during pressing?
